t: You're on Barnes Green, looking at the OSO Arts Centre, a 130-seat theatre in a building that used to be Barnes' postal sorting office. It was redeveloped in the late 1990s, and the arts centre opened in 2002. Today it offers evening performances and daytime dance and art classes. Its founder was Anne Carroll, an actress and director who ran the Barnes Theatre Company, a youth group, for two decades. In 2011 she received an MBE for services to community theatre in Barnes.
